Massachusetts Fun Facts

Boston Common: Opened in 1634, it is the oldest public park in the United States.
First Subway: Boston built America's first underground rapid transit system in 1897.
Harvard University: Founded in 1636 in Cambridge, it is the country's oldest institution of higher learning.
First Public School: Boston Public Schools traces its roots to America's first public school, established in 1635.
Basketball & Volleyball: Basketball was invented in Springfield in 1891; volleyball was created in Holyoke in 1895.
Chocolate Chip Cookie: Invented in 1938 by Ruth Graves Wakefield at the Toll House Inn in Whitman.
Marshmallow Fluff: Created in Somerville in 1917.
Dunkin': Its first location opened in Canton in 1948.
